result.summary: The page is largely well-formed. The main defect found is a nonsensical discount badge showing '–0%' on a restaurant card, which indicates a data or formatting bug. A couple of minor cosmetic inconsistencies were also noted.

issues.description: The pizza restaurant card in the 'Popular right now' section displays a '–0%' discount badge, which is meaningless to the user (a zero-percent discount) and suggests a data or template bug where the discount value is missing or zero.
issues.suggestion: Hide the discount badge entirely when the discount value is 0 or null, or ensure the correct discount percentage is passed to the badge component.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) buttons on the two 'Popular right now' cards have inconsistent backgrounds: the first appears as a plain white heart with no visible circular background, while the second has a dark semi-transparent circular background.
issues.suggestion: Apply a consistent style (e.g., the same semi-transparent circular background) to all favorite buttons over card images to ensure visibility and visual consistency.
